title: Strip surrounding whitespace
description: Write a function `strip_spaces(text)` that removes leading and trailing whitespace from `text`.
examples:
strip_spaces('   Coding For All      ')
-> 'Coding For All'
hints: text.strip() removes whitespace from both ends of the string, but leaves whitespace in the middle untouched.
Call .strip() on text and return the result.
expected_behavior: Returns text with leading/trailing whitespace removed, interior spaces unchanged.
explanation: strip() only trims the edges of the string - it's not the same as replace(' ', ''), which would also remove the space between 'Coding' and 'For'.
